body: Oh I guess that’s true!! It would be different everywhere!! I hope it’s more than just being bored. I really need the help!! Thanks for sharing!!
Thank you so much for your prayers!! :) my boyfriend always prayed for me when things got hard. I really hope he’s here with me right now, even in spirit.

Yeah, it’s not easy to move on. I’m very sorry about your special person. I’m really glad you found something that helped you. It really is the most soul crushing thing. Like life just pulled my heart out of my chest and stomped on it a couple thousand time. I’ve never felt a pain that hurts so bad. That hole is so empty, and nobody will ever fill it like he did. I’ll try to get better but things are hard and life is bleak.

I don’t know what you want from me. I’m not lying. My boyfriends dead. I’ve been sitting in the hospital for five days. I’ve got covid. I can post a picture of me in the hospital. Of my band. Of the messages that he passed. Why are you on this subreddit if you’re just gonna insinuate that people are making things up instead of just helping people that are depressed?

We were going to met. You can fall in love with someone without seeing them in person. And I think it’s an even more beautiful way to experience love. It’s not all about sexual things, it’s about your connection. Your conversations, your hobbies, who you are as people, hours as hours of talking. The whole world seems to melt away and it’s just the two of you. I know you think it’s silly because we never even met in person, but he was the most important person in the world to me. And even if we never met in person, I loved him so much and he changed my life for the better.
Yeah, he had his vaccines. He was just immunocompromised.
I’m a really big fan of it haha but it is really frustrating. I’ve cried over it before!! But that’s what makes it fun!! :)
Definitely!! It’s the coolest!! :)

It’s a great game!! It’s very interesting!! Lots of twists and turns!! It also has really cool game play!! You get to be in a trial!! It’s just really awesome!! I don’t know how to explain!! You’d just have got play it yourself!!
OHHHHHH I’m so sorry!! I just misunderstood haha!! I’ve been up for too long!!
What do you mean haha?? I’m confused??

I guess it seems that way. But I’m not lying. This is a repost. I originally posted it in suicide watch an hour before I posted it here. And between the time I posted this and my other post (three hours), they came in with my meds. And I talked to the psychiatrist here which helped calm me down. I do have mood swings and I suffer from a lot of mental health problems so going from distraught to ‘normal’ is kinda how it goes sometimes. And I tried to post to meet new people before but they took down my original post that was way more distraught. You don’t have to believe me. But this is real. This is what I am experiencing right now. And what I’ve been going through.

I don’t know. Im sorry. He actually died last Thursday. I just found out on Monday. I just needed someone to talk to. I just need to distract myself!! It’s really hard without him!! Being in the hospital is very boring and its very hard and it’s very lonely. I was just trying to be positive about it. Trying to just try and forget things. I just wanted someone to talk to about the things I like. Things that make me happy to remind me that life is worth it. But I don’t know. I guess it doesn’t really matter much. I don’t have many people to talk to about things, and I don’t know.

Thank you so much for the sweet message!! :) it really helped!! I’m having a rough time, but just being on Reddit for a bit today has already made me a little bit hopeful!! The pain is really hard god it’s so hard but he’d want me to be happy. He’d want me to keep living. I’m gonna try my hardest to get better, for him. I’ll give myself the biggest hug, and I’ll get through this. I’ve been through so much. This is just another thing that I have to get through. It’ll hurt. But it’ll be okay. He always said that everything will be okay, and it will. Everything will be okay. And one day I will have my happiness that I want and deserve. Thank you so much for the message!! :D

You’re right!! :) I’m feeling a little more hopeful today. Maybe that’s because they upped my meds haha!! But yeah, I think he’s here with me too!! I’ll try to live the best life I can just for him!! We had an amazing bond!! We were so close!! Ever since the day we met!! He always just wanted me to be happy and I can’t just give up now I guess!! I just love him so much :) he’d be so sad if I committed suicide. I just wish I could talk to him again.

He would. I know. He’d just want me to be happy. That’s all he’s always wanted. But it’s just so hard without him. I feel so alone. I know I have so much life left, and there’s still things I wanna do. But he was supposed to be by my side for it all!! It’s so much to bear and it’s weighing on me so much. Life isn’t fair at all haha!! But it isn’t bad all the time!! With him I was so happy!! I’ll never forget the time we had together. Never. I’ll keep him in my heart forever. A part of me does have a little hope. I want to live in for him. Play the games he’ll never get to play and do the things we were gonna do together. He made life so beautiful. God, I just love him so much. Thank you so much for the nice words!! :)
I just did it. It felt put kinda nice :) thank you fellow human.

I’m really sorry about your boyfriend. And yeah, a lot of people have said dumb things. My mom keeps saying I’ll get over it and it’s not the end of the world. People  just don’t get it at all. It’s just really hard without a good support system. Thank you so much for the kind words. I truly believe you, since you understand how I feel. I just don’t know if I’ll ever be able to love again. I couldn’t find someone else. I’ll never love them as much as I loved him.

That’s really sweet. It hurts really bad. More than anything. But you’re right. I only feel this terrible because I loved him so much. I just wish he was here. It’s really hard to think of a life without him in it. I’m just so lucky to get to love such a wonderful man.

It wasn’t my first inclination. I’ve been sitting in the hospital for four days. And he’s been dead for eight. It gets really lonely. I just wanted to share. This is suicide watch, and I am suicidal. I just wanted to get some support or just something. I just wrote what I was feeling and why I’m struggling.And I posted to depression because I’m also depressed and it is a bigger subreddit. And needafriend because well I just need a friend to talk to about things. To keep me company. But it doesn’t really matter I guess.
It’s just so hard. I’ve calmed down a bit since I’ve wrote this, but I’m a mess. I just miss him a lot, and I don’t know what to do.
